benchmark_results.notes: Per-row FT benchmark results (n_runs × n_tasks). Populated by Python benchmark runner via BENCH-SIDECAR-APPLY-001; drives the FT dashboard + staleness alert.

benchmark_runs.notes: One row per benchmark invocation. Feeds staleness alert + FT drift alert + DRIFT-TRIGGER-001's reflect pattern.

constraint_outcomes.notes: Guidance outcome telemetry — TELEMETRY-ONLY table (retrain consumes guidance_training_rows). See CLASSIFIER-CONSISTENCY-001.

context_catalog_versions.notes: Adaptive Builder version bump per space; consumed by the RRF context column.

contradicted_correction_drafts.notes: JIMINY-CONTRADICTED-BRIDGE-001 draft table; feeds the HITL review dataset.

embedding_events.notes: Per-embed attribution telemetry (EMBED-CALLSITE-001). 1.6M rows on mdemg-dev.

ft_benchmarks.notes: DROPPED in V0032 (FT-DORMANT-CLEANUP-001, 2026-07-30). Superseded by benchmark_runs + benchmark_results. 0 rows at drop time.

ft_hitl_decisions.notes: DROPPED in V0032 (FT-DORMANT-CLEANUP-001, 2026-07-30). Superseded by review_grades (V0028). 0 rows at drop time.

ft_model_versions.notes: Model version ledger + swap/rollback state. Load-bearing for the drift alert + trigger.

ft_training_cycles.notes: Event-sourced retrain-cycle ledger. The single source of truth for 'is a cycle running'.

guidance_conflicts.notes: Divergence between guidance items; feeds jiminy dashboard. 8.7k rows on mdemg-dev.

guidance_training_rows.notes: Retrain evidence corpus for JIMINY guidance. GUIDANCE-AUDIT-001 relabels heuristic rows; data curate-guidance emits the versioned corpus.

llm_endpoint_health_events.notes: MLX/llama-server health-probe transitions. LOW volume (34 rows on mdemg-dev).

llm_interactions.notes: Every LLM call recorded. 107k rows on mdemg-dev. Highest-fanout consumer table.

writers: internal/metrics/tsdb_flusher.go (60s flush of the registry snapshot)
metric_samples.notes: Central metrics hypertable. 80M rows on mdemg-dev; retention/compression via V0025.

readers: mdemg model verify + list (CLI reads recent installs)
model_install_events.notes: Model pull/verify/remove audit trail. LOW volume (3 rows).

reinforcement_events.notes: Hebbian co-activation reinforcement events. 556k rows on mdemg-dev. Feeds event-graph federation.

retrieval_audit.notes: Per-retrieve audit trail with scorer_version + consensus_strength. Feeds scorer-drift tripwires.

retrieval_events.notes: Retrieve activity events; broader companion to retrieval_audit.

review_grades.notes: HITL review grade rows. 18 rows on mdemg-dev. WARNING: suggested_guidance column is populated (11%) but has ZERO code consumers — a column-level dormant surface disclosed by DORMANT-CENSUS-002. Field intent is SME corrective-example retrain input but no consumer wired.

rl_training_runs.notes: GRPO training run manifest. 1 row on mdemg-dev; wired but rarely fired (RL runs are infrequent operator-triggered).

rl_training_steps.notes: Per-step GRPO telemetry. 2 rows on mdemg-dev; wired to run alongside rl_training_runs.

scheduled_job_events.notes: Scheduled/background job success/failure ledger. 1.6k rows on mdemg-dev. Load-bearing for silent-failure prevention.

sparse_gate_metrics.notes: Per-call sparse-retrieval gate telemetry. 7.2k rows on mdemg-dev.

uvts_results.notes: UVTS per-question grades. 488 rows on mdemg-dev.

uvts_runs.notes: UVTS run manifest paired with uvts_results.
